doc.title: Louis Armstrong and Herman Chittison Interview, 1960-05-04

title: Armstrong and Chittison reunion over the 1934 Paris album
summary: The host introduces Armstrong and pianist Herman Chittison, who recorded together in Europe 25 years earlier. They recall the St. Louis Blues session, Sunnyside and the Brussels photo shoot.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan
